definitions.near_body: upper wick/body ratio 0.75–1.25; upper wick >=1.5x lower wick
definitions.confirmation_body: immediately next candle bearish close below lower edge of rejection candle body
definitions.confirmation_extreme: immediately next candle close below rejection candle low
definitions.historical_resistance: confirmed H1/H4 swing high, or H1/H4 swing low broken by earlier H1 close
definitions.monthly_close: any completed month close within 18 months, known before signal
definitions.tolerance: max($1,0.12 x H1 ATR) from upper wick tip, with signal close below level
definitions.entry: sell limit at upper edge of rejection candle body, placed after next confirmation candle closes
definitions.reset: after fill, require $0.50 downward departure before first revisit
definitions.revisit: first M1 high >= entry after documented departure; 0 excursion if immediate revisit
definitions.excursion: entry - lowest M1 low BEFORE revisit minute; conservative when M1 candle ordering unknown
definitions.censor: maximum 24h after fill; unreturned reported separately, not assumed returned
definitions.no_trade_costs: price excursion in USD/oz; no spread or slippage deducted
definitions.overlap: every qualifying candle; many overlap, so not independent portfolio trades

caveats: A confirmed candle may not fill the limit; fill rate reported.
24h non-return observations are right-censored; report separately.
If the fill minute moved down before touching the limit, M1 OHLC cannot reveal order; fill-minute movement excluded.
First-return excursion is not realized profit, and no costs or stop are modeled.
The near-level filter uses a pre-confirmed pivot, but overlap makes naive confidence intervals invalid.
This is not a proof of an institutional or secret level.
